about: The introitus of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass I” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant them eternal rest, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. A hymn is fitting for You, O God, in Sion, and to You a vow will be rendered in Jerusalem. Hear my prayer: all flesh will come to You. Grant them eternal rest, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them.
